subject: Oversight Guidelines for School Support Organizations
overview: The committee debated new financial and governance oversight rules for parent-teacher organizations following a transparency controversy at the McGlynn School. Members also received updates on the superintendent search and referred a study of alternative 'blizzard bag' learning options for snow days to subcommittee.

items.title: Minutes, Bills, and Payrolls
items.summary: Approved minutes from the December 18 meeting, bills, fund transfers, and payrolls.

items.title: Organizational and Committee Reports
items.summary: Approved the January 3 organizational report designating Mea Mustone as Vice Chairperson and Kathy Kreatz as Secretary; tabled the January 3 Committee of the Whole report and approved the January 16 report regarding the superintendent search.

items.title: Roberts PTO Playground Grant
items.summary: Referred a request to support a Community Preservation Commission grant application for playground restoration to the Building and Grounds subcommittee.

items.title: Superintendent Search and MASC Participation
items.summary: Discussed the search timeline and the role of the Massachusetts Association of School Committees (MASC) in screening candidates and managing public focus groups.

items.title: Foreign Language Director Search
items.summary: Approved the commencement of a search for a new foreign language director to replace the retiring Rita DeCarlo.

items.title: DESE Initiatives and Religious Observances
items.summary: Accepted reports on the state's 'Leading the Nation' educational initiative and protocols for accommodating diverse religious holidays.

items.title: Inclement Weather and Blizzard Bags
items.summary: Discussed school closing criteria and referred the study of 'blizzard bags' for remote learning during extended snow closures to the Curriculum subcommittee.

items.title: Oversight Guidelines for PTO, PTG, and 501c3 Organizations
items.summary: Referred proposed registration and financial transparency guidelines for school-affiliated support groups to the Rules subcommittee. The discussion included testimony from McGlynn PTG leadership and parents regarding past tax filing errors and current governance disputes.

items.title: School Lunch Policy and Cafeteria Wages
items.summary: Approved the USDA-mandated school lunch charge policy and a wage increase for substitute cafeteria workers from $11 to $13 per hour.

items.title: Overnight Field Trip and Paperwork Streamlining
items.summary: Approved a Tufts Mountain Club ski trip and referred the streamlining of field trip approval forms to the Rules subcommittee.

items.title: Document Digitization and Public Access
items.summary: Referred a proposal to move toward paperless meetings and post all agenda backup documents online to the Community Relations subcommittee.
